## Change

Describe the concrete problem, the resulting behavior/content, and why the change is supported.

## Evidence and scope

For content changes, link the sources and explain what they support, including version/mode or historical context. State any remaining uncertainty. For code-only changes, write “Not applicable”.

Do not paste private moderation records, hashes, personal information, credentials or private source text here. Public source provenance belongs in `CONTENT_SOURCES.md`; private queue references stay private.

## Review checklist

- [ ] I followed `CONTRIBUTING.md` and the relevant standard in `MODERATION.md`.
- [ ] Content changes have supported usage/meaning, compliant taxonomy, resolved related terms, and no alias/route collisions (or not applicable).
- [ ] Status, historical context and `needsUpdating` changes are justified by evidence (or not applicable).
- [ ] New/replaced media has provenance, accurate attribution and verified source/inline playback (or not applicable).
- [ ] UUIDs/routes are preserved, and new/renamed/category-changed vote targets have the required migration (or not applicable).
- [ ] I ran `npm run check` and relevant browser/database checks; results and any unavailable checks are listed below.

## Validation

List actual commands/results and any remaining limitations. Passing CI does not approve factual claims or publish the change; publication remains an explicit maintainer action.
